request: Run a win-loss analysis on our closed deals for the last 12 months. Tell us why we lose, which competitors beat us and where, which marketing channels bring deals we can win, and give us a buyer interview guide for next quarter. Deal size bands: under $10k, $10k to $30k, $30k and up.
business: Example Dispatch Software, field service management software for HVAC, plumbing and electrical contractors, sold by a sales team on annual contracts (invented example)

answers_to_before_you_start.outcomes: Won, Lost, No decision. Housekeeping values set aside (records, not buying decisions): Duplicate, Test deal.
answers_to_before_you_start.list_price: list_amount_usd = technicians x monthly list price x 12 ($60 for 1-10, $55 for 11-50, $50 for 51+)

sources.crm_export: Uploaded CSV: every deal created or closed in the window, open deals included (no CRM connector; the export is the source).
sources.call_notes: Pasted rep notes, keyed by deal id.
sources.interviews: Pasted lines from 20 buyer interviews held 14 to 40 days after close, keyed by deal id. Interviewees are described by role, never named.
sources.platform_leads: Pulled through the InsightfulPipe MCP for the cohort window: Google Ads gaql (conversions by action), LinkedIn Ads get_account_analytics, GA4 get_report (key events by source, medium and event), CallRail get_calls (first-time calls).
